basis.text: The licence looked up is ABC Type 21, as stated in the description.
The licence is to be obtained as a new licence, as the applicant states.
Census tract 209.00: 8 active off-sale retail licences in ABC's licences as they stood on 22 July 2024, against 3 authorised in ABC's census tract authorisations of September 2026.

The tract is over its authorised number, and state law tests a new licence for undue concentration. The licence may still issue if public convenience or necessity would be served: public convenience or necessity finding likely required.
The rules cannot tell which limb of § 23958.4(b) reaches ABC Type 21: whether the applicant shows public convenience or necessity to ABC, or the local governing body determines it.
ABC investigates every licence application, and the applicant must post public notice, before a licence is issued: further review.
basis.code_section: California Business and Professions Code §§ 23958 (investigation) and 23985 (public notice)
